resources.string: This app has no flag inside it. The flag is issued by a server, over a pinned TLS channel, only to a fresh hardware-attested proof from the genuine, correctly-signed build. Two flags: tier 1 for a hardware-attested device, tier 2 additionally requires a locked bootloader with verified boot. Extract the flag.
Connect to the internet to obtain the flag.
This device has no hardware-backed attestation.
Attestation service is unavailable. Try again later.
Accepted — this device does not have a verified bootloader.
Accepted — device and app fully verified.
